tooltip.ltwterraformer.creative_terrafor: Thirteen creative terrain, sculpting and building operations with live previews.
Use the LTW keybinds shown in the HUD
Offhand block selects the brush material
Remote edits can target loaded blocks up to 256 blocks away
tooltip.ltwterraformer.survival_builder_: Extends faces, bridges, stairs, fills craters, and builds two-corner boxes and walls.
Offhand block overrides the targeted material
Use the LTW Cycle Pattern key or sneak-right-click
Copies complete builds, including beds, torches, signs, containers, and inventories.
Right-click start, footprint, then height; sneak-right-click changes mode
Press G for the blueprint book; R rotates the paste
Survival pastes use the blocks you carry
